$comment: Values that both TypeScript and the build scripts need. lib/site.ts imports this; scripts/gen-qr.mjs reads it. Change a value here and every canonical URL, QR code, sitemap entry, OG tag, and contact link follows.

contact.$comment: Null until a real inbox exists. Every contact link falls back to GitHub issues rather than printing an address that bounces. Set `email` once and support, legal, and trust pages all pick it up.
